$comment: Stage outputs of the intake rule (tool-evaluation-by-use §5b) for one owner-shared post. A: one self-scan acting as the resource (opus). B: three read-only confirmers (sonnet). C: the coordinating session's decision. Model output throughout: quoted by the intake row, never a fixture or a figure. The resource is a post with no source repository, so it was READ, not run; §4 and §5 do not apply. Measurements about the Mac's private local runtime and hardware were taken and are deliberately not recorded in this public tree.

resources.name: "Claude Code GOD MODE" model-tiering post, with a second part adapting it to other vendors' models
resources.author: not named

proposals.what: Use the strongest tier for planning, research and review and a cheaper tier for mechanical implementation; keep context small with auto-compaction.
proposals.alreadyHere: DR-047 rule 2 already routes bulk mechanical work, implementation and judgment to three tiers and rule 1 forbids an inherited tier. Measured: 15 files in .claude/agents, 8 opus, 6 sonnet, 1 haiku, 0 without a model line; scripts/check-skill-plane-conformance.mjs fails an agent with no model line or one outside the three tiers. Both workflow scripts name a tier on every spawn: land-branch.js 9 of 9 (6 haiku, 3 sonnet), review-wave.js 2 of 2 (sonnet review, opus refute).
trials: The post's own two price points give a ratio of 40.0 on input and 40.0 on output; its '1/40th' figure is that per-token ratio, reached only if no tokens stay on the top tier, which its own design does not do.
No price table exists in the tree, so the prices and the 1/40 figure are unverifiable here and are not recorded as facts.
No auto-compaction setting or utilization measurement was found; the '40-60%' figure is unverifiable here.
The model names in the post's second part do not match what is configured on the Mac's private local runtime.
